table.retrieve:
SELECT Item.Name,  
			aliasname=item.customicode, 
			active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
         Item.purprice,   
         Item.PackUnits,   
         QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),   
         Manufacturer.name,
			classname=itemclass.name,
			Category=itemcategory.name,  
			UnitPrice = Case :ai_pricetype 
								WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / Item.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / Item.PackUnits, 2)
                     	WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
                     END ,
			PackQty = Round(isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) / Item.packUnits, 2),
         StockValue = isnull(Sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) *
                      Case :ai_pricetype 
								 WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / Item.PackUnits, 2)
                     	 WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / Item.PackUnits, 2)
                     	 WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
                     END

    FROM 
		Manufacturer,   
		Item
		LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode),
		ItemCategory,
		itemclass

   WHERE 
			( GodownDetail.GCode IN (:gcode) ) and
         ( Item.ICCode IN (:classcode ) ) and
			( itemclass.iccode = Item.iccode ) and
			( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
			( Item.active=1) and
			( Item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)
			

GROUP BY Item.name,item.customicode, Item.Active, Item.purprice, Item.PackUnits,Itemclass.name,
			itemcategory.name,
			 Itemclass.name ,
			 Manufacturer.name
order by itemclass.name, item.name
